dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: This? This is an aquabus — the most advanced transportation device in Fontaine... Probably!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: I've heard that some people are working on a boat that can fly in the sky. That sounds awesome, right? If boats really could do that...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Wait, that's bad! That would cause... seasick? Airsick? Either way, passengers who get sick will be in great danger.
